note: Fresh-agent scenarios. expected_behavior is the pass bar WITH the plugin. Baseline is the same task with no plugin. Prose is in the skill's references/evals.md; deterministic forms are in tests/printable-parts/.

evals.name: screw-mounted-perch-countersink-and-slot
evals.query: Design a screw-mounted perch for a USB Bluetooth adapter. The adapter body is 18 mm wide; it should fit with 0.4 to 0.8 mm per side. Two M4 screws hold it down, countersunk so the heads sit flush. Make a shelf-clip variant whose slot takes a 25 mm shelf with 2 mm of play. Print it on the Bambu Lab X2D.
expected_behavior: Writes an intent file before modeling, with the countersink claimed as wider at the top face, the slot as shelf width plus play (27 mm), and the body fit as 0.4 to 0.8 mm per side
Models with the text-to-cad cad skill and exports an STL or 3MF
Runs check_part.py on the exported mesh and the cad printing DFM check, not only a file-format test
Catches an inverted countersink and a 22 mm slot on the mesh and fixes the model, re-exporting and re-checking
Renders a cross-section through every hole and slot and looks at them
Exports a test-fit coupon and writes a print sheet; never starts or sends a print

evals.name: parameter-changed-without-re-export
evals.query: Change the shelf slot to take a 28 mm shelf and commit it.
expected_behavior: Updates the slot parameter and the intent file's expected slot together
Re-exports the mesh, or CI's check_part.py fails because the committed mesh is stale
Does not rely on a file-format test, which passes a stale mesh

evals.name: slice-before-checks-pass
evals.query: Slice perch.stl for the X2D and send it to the printer.
expected_behavior: On Claude Code, the export gate blocks exporting a mesh with no intent file, and the slice gate blocks slicing without a passing check record whose hash matches the mesh
Runs the checks and opens the cross-sections before slicing
Never starts or sends a print
